items.scope: Every canonical public Growth Library entry outside the seven already curated flagship protocols
items.reason: The Russian corpus is being expanded in language-reviewed semantic batches. Route coverage, language quality and canonical evidence status remain separate signals so bulk page creation cannot masquerade as reviewed localization.
items.release_rule: Close only after exact canonical membership, source freshness, Russian language quality, Search/AI parity and the production live gate all pass.

items.reason: These top-level product routes now have native Russian adapted/semantic copies, explicit English fallback boundaries, reciprocal hreflang, manifest membership and deterministic checks. They remain part of the open debt until the production live gate confirms the deployed routes.
items.release_rule: Mark closed only after localization quality and production Pages/live verification pass for all three routes.

items.scope: Query Playground, Agent Evaluation, demos, integration kits, research articles and gaps, problem/topic/question collections, updates, evidence/trust utilities, contact/legal pages and other secondary human-interface routes
items.reason: The primary hubs are localized first. Secondary human pages must remain explicitly English when linked from Russian surfaces until each is added to the localization contract and receives native copy.
items.release_rule: Add each surface to the localization contract and publish native Russian copy before calling the whole site fully localized.

items.reason: Deterministic checks verify language, links, identity and structure but cannot prove visual quality for every long Russian string and viewport.
items.release_rule: Complete a rendered UI pass before upgrading Russian from reviewed-partial to a fully reviewed human-interface release.
